intent: Record as reviewed the run and generation allowance and download retention rules the policy Context enforces and tests but the Registry did not hold.
observable_outcome: get-context policy lists the eight rules as reviewed, each citing its enforcing code and the test that proves it.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A Workspace that has used its daily allowance in the trailing 24 hours is refused with reason quota_daily, and the message says when it resets.
A Workspace that has used its rolling-window allowance is refused with reason quota_window, and the message says when the next one frees up.
When usage cannot be counted the request is refused with ErrAllowanceUnavailable and a *_unavailable reason; it is never read as unused and never reported as exhausted.
Generations and runs have separate allowances: a spent generation allowance refuses with ErrGenerateQuotaExceeded, never the run refusal, and the reverse.
An allowance is enforced only when it has a window length and at least one ceiling; a zero or partial configuration refuses nothing.
The remaining allowance a Workspace sees is clamped at zero; an overspent Workspace reads 0, not a negative number.
By default a Workspace may start 5 runs a day and 30 per 30 days, and 20 in its first 30 days.
Download retention must be a positive duration; zero or negative is refused with ErrRetentionNotConfigured rather than meaning keep forever or delete at once.
